title: wwwa-jul-1999-world-heavyweight
label: Razor

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames Razor as the reigning World Heavyweight Champion throughout this record; no winning document survives.

note: Never shown defending the title in this record.

title: wwwa-jul-1999-cruiserweight
label: "The Rocket" Jarry Rice

won.source: Awarded the vacant title by the promotion's own on-screen commissioner, Chris Bane, after Tommy Brooks's retirement.

note: Lost the title to a masked challenger, later unmasked as Mike Holmes, in a mask-versus-title match.

won.source: Won the Cruiserweight Championship from Jarry Rice in a mask-versus-title match, with help from a second masked accomplice, then unmasked.

title: wwwa-jul-1999-cruiserweight
label: "Traditional" Tommy Brooks

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames Brooks as the reigning Cruiserweight Champion entering the 22 September 1999 broadcast.

note: Brooks announced his retirement live on the air, vacating the title with no notice.

won.source: Won the World Tag Team Championship from the Too Cool Connection when Oracle shoved a rival off the top rope and Prophet made the cover.

title: wwwa-jul-1999-world-tag-team
label: Too Cool Connection

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames the Too Cool Connection as the reigning World Tag Team Champions entering the 6 October 1999 broadcast.

note: Lost the title to the Dark Forces after a distracted referee missed a successful cover of their own.

title: wwwa-jul-1999-hardcore
label: Cryptic Saber

won.source: Won an eight-man battle royal through the arena's own parking garage to become the promotion's first Hardcore Champion.

note: Successfully defended the title against Alec "The Destroyer" Empire in a boiler room brawl on 6 October 1999.
